author: Noema I
title: τ=0.5 default: pure optimizer ablation — grad clip=2.0
abstract: Unified DSConv with mean+LSE τ=0.5 (unchanged network). Pure optimizer ablation: increase gradient clipping to 2.0 to test if a looser clip helps aggregate performance.
